oneOf.description: Inspect the current document, revision, capabilities and engine.
Read every page/frame and the selected frame text; offsets belong to the selected frame.
Replace a UTF-16 range on grapheme boundaries. Revision and idempotency key are required.
Format a UTF-16 range, retaining explicit font/language and custom spacing.
Atomically save a lab document; detects external changes and protects source files.
Open or migrate a document; fontPaths resolves exact hashes at new paths.
Set dimensions and margins for one page. Full content frames follow its content area.
Undo a document, page, frame, text or formatting transaction.
Redo an undone document transaction.
Inspect loaded font identities and the registered layer recipe.
Privately load a local static TTF without a system font install.
Inspect the page and all its frame glyphs, including overflow.
Map page coordinates to frame identity and native UTF-16 caret.
Render the shared glyph layout to PNG, optionally a bounded tile for a huge page.
Control layer visibility, flat layer colors, preview mode, zoom and overlays. monochromePaper selects black or white paper for monochrome preview and proofs; auto follows the document background.
Toggle kerning and standard ligatures; reuses the same text source.
Select a grapheme-aligned UTF-16 range, optionally in another frame.
Read native accessibility, selection and UI state.
Save a PNG of the lab widget for local troubleshooting.
Read recent correlated diagnostics.
Create a new document; explicit discard is required for unsaved text.
Rename the document.
Validate a file and list exact missing font identities without changing the document.
Save at a new path, retaining the previous document and its recovery history.
List recent local document paths.
Find literal text on grapheme boundaries across all frames.
Replace all literal matches as one undoable transaction.
Set line height, paragraph spacing, alignment and left tab stops.
Add an independent page with a full content frame.
Remove a page and its frames; undo restores all content.
Add an independent text frame to the selected page; coordinates use points.
Select the editing frame and invalidate commands prepared for a previous frame.
Set frame position, dimensions, label and visible/clipped overflow.
Remove a text frame; undo restores its full semantic text.
List named character styles.
Create or replace a named character style.
Apply a named character style to the selected frame range.
Validate and select three compatible fonts for registered flat color.
Apply an explicit three-color palette to the current recipe.
Return plain source text and semantic clipboard data for a selection.
Paste validated semantic clipboard data without discarding run metadata.
List recoverable checkpoints from sessions that are no longer running.
Recover an interrupted session without overwriting its source document.
List revision summaries, undo capacity and the last durable revision.
Export a portable outline SVG proof; bitmap-only glyphs fail explicitly.
Read persisted frame policy, flow chains and versioned line-break profiles.
Enable derived layout, leading distribution and baseline grid for the source frame.
Apply keep-with-next, keep-together and widow/orphan minima to selected paragraphs.
Flow one source story through empty equal-width frames; never duplicate or delete source text.
Create a new revision of explicit language line-break tailoring; no automatic hyphenation dictionary.
Inspect native and tailored Unicode break opportunities with source offsets.
Explicitly insert a soft hyphen or line separator at a grapheme boundary.
Set allow/warn/repair, minimum clearance, expansion/iteration budget and reserved bounds.
Report before/after collisions, protected joins, solver decisions and unresolved constraints.
Replace explicit pair spacing rules, stored separately from font kerning. Legacy independence must be declared.
Measure an isolated pair with/without font kerning and explicit optical spacing; live source is unchanged.
Create an editable dense specimen on a new page from explicit source symbols.
Show or hide source/diagnostics, select a control panel, toggle guides and fit the page for visual review.
Read versioned lighting, source bindings, page background and raster settings.
Change the outline-derived paint recipe and advance its revision; source text is unchanged.
Bind an exact font identity to verified layer fonts or derived treatment; roman-translation-1 selects the independent archived Roman bevel/glow profile.
Configure page background (#AARRGGBB) and default raster DPI.
Inspect all pages, font identities, overset, effect clipping and extraction limitations.
Export PNG, SVG or multipage PDF; decorative SVG/PDF requires explicit raster policy and DPI.
Build the explicitly reduced flat COLR v0/CPAL font plus reproducible provenance manifest; retain mono outlines.
Render a glyph composite or an individual source layer on a shared canvas; report exact layer registration.
Read a language revision, collection or record with immutable identities and provenance.
List language revisions pinned in this document, including hashes and collection counts.
Inspect added, removed and changed records before adopting another revision. Page text never changes.
Pin a previously retained language revision; existing corpus links retain their original revision.
Create or replace one typed record as a new immutable language revision. Stable IDs survive edits.
Remove a record in a new revision; referenced records cannot be removed. Undo restores the prior pin.
Verify and import both local translation charts, language terms, glosses, tense conflict, orthography and Unta data into a new revision.
Import a hash-checked portable language package as a new revision; retain the previous revision.
Export the selected revision as portable, hash-checked JSON with original citations. Does not include document text or fonts.
Publish a searchable, printable dictionary, grammar book or interlinear corpus from the pinned data.
Search headwords, senses, labels and variants literally; no normalization of historical spellings.
Apply an explicit transliteration profile. Forward trace preserves unknown slots and ambiguous reverse readings.
Insert a registered symbol key through the guarded native text writer; requires an exact compatible selected font.
Literal concordances and surface frequencies in the pinned corpus. Entry search uses explicit token links.
Inspect bilingual document links, including stale text ranges and links pinned to older language revisions.
Link a cited corpus pair to explicit source/translation UTF-16 document ranges. Adaptations must be documented.
Remove a document corpus link; undo restores it.
Format exact integer-string numerator/denominator values in a versioned base-12 convention; report repeats or truncation.
Parse finite or repeating base-12 notation to an exact reduced rational, without floating point.
Expand, collapse, pin or resize the left controls. Saved workspace preferences; no document, zoom or undo change. Collapsing unpins; pinning expands.
Read left-panel visibility, pin, remembered width, selected tab and preference errors.
Choose Select to click a frame to edit, or Hand to drag the view. No document revision or undo entry.
Move the page by viewport logical pixels, without changing text, selection or document history.
Bring the current page back to the center of the viewport.
Read the active navigation tool, page origin, viewport and zoom.
Read bounded shaping/cache counters and reliability limits.
Back up the last saved file and exact font bytes into a verified portable bundle. Does not save unsaved edits.
Verify every bundle member and all source font identities without opening the document.
Recover to a NEW directory, retaining the exact original and relocating verified font paths. Does not replace the open editor.
Start an isolated cancellable PNG/SVG/PDF proof from the current immutable revision; inspect jobs.status for completion or errors.
Inspect proof job state, phase, revision, staleness, output and full worker log path.
Cancel this editor’s proof worker before publication. Never writes a partial destination.
Create an independent local language project. Does not change the Workbench document.
Open a Forge SQLite project. Existing drafts are already durable.
Read an immutable version or the active autosaved draft, including dictionary, wiki and tests.
Read project identity, generation, active branch, head and draft status.
List immutable language versions with parent hashes.
Compare stable records, wiki pages and tests between two versions.
Validate and atomically autosave an entire proposed snapshot. Commit separately to name its version.
Autosave a wiki page, test or typed language record with stable identity and a project generation guard.
Atomically freeze the entire dictionary, wiki, grammar, decisions and test suite as a named version.
Create and select a branch from an immutable version. Retains the old branch draft.
Select a branch without discarding either branch draft.
Export all committed versions, branch drafts and run records as a hashed portable bundle.
Restore a verified Forge bundle to a NEW project path.
Run language assertions and render a frozen bilingual test with the approved presentation. Meaning still requires review.
Inspect test outcomes, pinned versions, diagnostics and output paths.
Open a generated test in a separate Workbench process, preserving this document. Logs stdout/stderr.
Show Workbench or Forge and select its workspace section/version or stable wiki/entry/test ID without modifying the document.
Read the versioned rule and test definitions; omit version for the durable draft.
Validate and autosave a declarative rule or test case; commit separately to freeze it.
Remove a draft case or unreferenced rule. Frozen versions retain the original.
Evaluate finite forms, scalar inventory and explicitly annotated clauses. Draft previews are not frozen runs.
Run the frozen language suite and retain coverage, expected/actual results and content hashes in a new directory.
Run exactly the same pinned cases against two frozen language versions. Defaults to the before version suite.
Plan a three-way merge from a branch frozen head into the active clean branch. Inspect base, parents and every conflict.
Atomically commit a reviewed merge with both parents. Require the exact preview, generation and every conflict resolution.
List immutable named language releases and pinned versions; releases never follow a moving branch.
Read a named language release, embedded test evidence and outstanding review status.
Freeze a named release with matching suite and bound-page evidence. Experimental releases retain review gaps; stable gates require full passes and an accepting reviewer.
Export a language release with its dictionary, wiki, assertions and embedded reports. Proof/font binaries remain separately hash-referenced.
Read versioned optional forms and repetition watch definitions.
Validate and save variation proposals in the guarded draft; commit separately to freeze them.
Inspect full and optional forms with explicit author-supplied context. No automatic rewriting.
Inspect repetition in a versioned page. Advisory counts cannot certify natural language.
Save a frozen repetition audit with snapshot, page and watch hashes.
Compare page text in two versions with identical watch definitions from the after version.
Read versioned Maxima policy and paired letter identities.
Validate and save the guarded draft spelling policy; does not rewrite text.
Preview exact sentence-initial Maxima edits on a selected page. No Unicode uppercase or automatic typing.
Apply the exact reviewed draft preview; clone source cases, preserve earlier cases and update bound page atomically.
Inspect mapped sentence initials, missing Maxima and unresolved initial scalars.
Freeze a spelling audit and its exact input hashes.
Inspect retained and conditional clause orders for explicit discourse context; does not reorder text.
Read the versioned parallel reading profile and modes.
Enable the verified Thimfora 79 / transliteration 7 reading profile in the guarded draft.
Inspect exact parallel text, Maxima/Minima counts and font-reading evidence.
Create a separate editable transliteration or literal Roman copy of this two-column page. Source stays unchanged.
Show one current page or a facing pair. Workspace preference only; preserves document content, page geometry, zoom and undo history. Inspect page offsets with view.inspect.
